moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City in the opening match.

angles.name: Kick-off excitement
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Opening Match Focus
angles.copy: It all starts Friday! Arsenal take on newly promoted Coventry City in the Premier League opener. Prediction time!

moments.title: UK Singles Chart #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean hold the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart this week with 'Rein Me In'.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Massive congrats to Sam Fender & Olivia Dean! 'Rein Me In' is your Official UK Singles Chart Number 1. What a tune!

angles.name: Listen Now
angles.copy: Hear the UK's Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is on repeat. What are your favourite tracks in the Top 40?

moments.title: UK Albums Chart #1
moments.blurb: The album 'A Love Letter To A Broken Town' has landed at Number 1 on the Official UK Albums Chart this week.

angles.name: Album Chart Success
angles.copy: Big news on the Official UK Albums Chart! 'A Love Letter To A Broken Town' is this week's Number 1. Have you heard it yet?

moments.title: New Channel 4 Drama: Complicit

angles.name: New Murder Mystery
angles.copy: Channel 4 just announced 'Complicit', a gripping new murder mystery starring Claire Goose. Who's ready for some serious suspense?

angles.name: Thrilling Drama
angles.copy: Suburban secrets and devastating lies are at the heart of Channel 4's newly announced drama 'Complicit'. Sounds like a must-watch!

moments.title: Ludwig Season 2 Returns
moments.blurb: David Mitchell's acclaimed puzzle-solving detective series 'Ludwig' returns for its second season tomorrow, Thursday August 20th, on BBC One and iPlayer.

angles.name: Mitchell's Return
angles.copy: David Mitchell is back! 'Ludwig' Season 2 starts tomorrow on BBC One. Get ready for more impossible crimes and brilliant deductions.

angles.name: Binge-Watch Ready
angles.copy: Good news, 'Ludwig' fans! The first three episodes of Season 2 drop on BBC iPlayer tomorrow. Perfect for a binge-watch!

angles.name: Boxing Drama
angles.copy: Get ready for the intensity of 'Fightland'! This new drama hits Sky Atlantic next Wednesday, August 27th. Who's tuning in?
